data.one_liner: Hides app content in the app switcher and displays a frost barrier when returning to the app.
data.what_it_does: Protects application content visibility when the user leaves the app or switches apps. It hides content in the task switcher and displays a customizable blur or frost barrier above locked content until unlocked.
use_when: You are building apps with sensitive data (like banking or personal records) that need to be hidden in the app switcher.
You want to trigger biometric or custom authentication flows when the user returns to the app.
avoid_when: You only need local storage encryption without UI visibility handling.
You do not target mobile platforms or web/windows where app visibility states apply.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and Windows.
Provides streams for authentication and lock events to easily hook into app lifecycle security.
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation of authentication UI and logic (does not bundle biometrics out of the box).
Platform-specific behaviors like FLAG_SECURE on Android automatically block screenshots.
data.setup_notes: No special permissions documented beyond standard plugin integration.
